property_summary: For any inputs to initialize, the reference contract stores baseToken equal to the provided _baseToken argument (i.e. c.baseToken() == _baseToken); the mutant swaps and sets baseToken == _nft, so there exist inputs where c.baseToken() != _baseToken causing the property to fail.
change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken so initialize sets baseToken equal to nft (swap), making baseToken equal to the provided _nft instead of _baseToken.
